description: Verbes à particule, expressions courantes, nuances de certitude et faux amis : ce qui distingue le niveau 6.

fiches.question: To cancel something that was planned.
fiches.explication: The search was called off at night.

fiches.question: To delay someone or something.
fiches.explication: We were held up by a late passenger.

fiches.question: To use all of something so that none is left.
fiches.explication: We are about to run out of time on our duty.

fiches.question: To support or confirm what someone says.
fiches.explication: The other crew backed up our report.

fiches.question: To continue.
fiches.explication: Carry on with the checklist.

fiches.question: To find or meet by chance.
fiches.explication: We came across a lot of birds near the coast.

fiches.question: To understand or find the answer after thinking.
fiches.explication: We are trying to figure out why the warning came on.

fiches.question: To succeed in making contact by radio or phone.
fiches.explication: We couldn't get through to the company on the frequency.

fiches.question: To investigate.
fiches.explication: Maintenance will look into the problem.

fiches.question: To postpone.
fiches.explication: The departure has been put off until tomorrow.

fiches.question: To cause an alarm or a warning to start.
fiches.explication: A passenger smoking in the lavatory set off the smoke detector.

fiches.question: To solve a problem or put something in order.
fiches.explication: Ground staff are sorting out the baggage problem.

fiches.question: To prove to be, in the end.
fiches.explication: The warning turned out to be false.

fiches.question: To move an event to an earlier time.
fiches.explication: The meeting was brought forward to nine.

fiches.question: (Of a machine) to stop working.
fiches.explication: The tug broke down halfway through the pushback.

fiches.question: To move or progress at the same speed as someone or something.
fiches.explication: The ground staff could not keep up with the arrivals.

fiches.question: To wait and be ready.
fiches.explication: Stand by for a new clearance.

fiches.question: (Of an effect) to disappear slowly.
fiches.explication: The effect of the medicine is wearing off.

fiches.question: A rough estimate.
fiches.explication: Give me a ballpark figure for the delay.

fiches.question: Alert and quick to understand.
fiches.explication: The new controller is really on the ball.

fiches.question: Uncertain, with a real risk of failure.
fiches.explication: It was touch and go whether we'd land before the storm.

fiches.question: Not yet decided.
fiches.explication: Our return flight is still up in the air.

fiches.question: Strictly following the rules.
fiches.explication: The captain does everything by the book.

fiches.question: A practical method based on experience rather than exact calculation.
fiches.explication: As a rule of thumb, start the descent at three times your altitude in thousands of feet.

fiches.question: Kept informed.
fiches.explication: Please keep me in the loop.

fiches.question: An advance warning.
fiches.explication: Thanks for the heads-up about the icing.

fiches.question: A narrow escape from danger.
fiches.explication: That was a close call with the drone.

fiches.question: To stop working for now.
fiches.explication: After the third delay, the crew called it a day.

fiches.question: To learn how to do something.
fiches.explication: You'll soon get the hang of the new software.

fiches.question: Taking extra care to avoid risk.
fiches.explication: Just to be on the safe side, we'll request the fire services.

fiches.question: To do something quickly or cheaply by skipping steps.
fiches.explication: Never cut corners on a walk-around.

fiches.question: Please be patient while I do something.
fiches.explication: Bear with me, I'm checking the fuel figures.

fiches.question: Without checking or thinking carefully.
fiches.reponse: off the top of my head
fiches.explication: Off the top of my head, about forty minutes.

fiches.question: In very few words.
fiches.explication: In a nutshell, we can't land here today.

fiches.question: With little warning (US: on short notice).
fiches.explication: The runway was closed at short notice.

fiches.question: The most important point or fact.
fiches.explication: The bottom line is that we need more fuel.

fiches.question: Certainly, without any doubt.
fiches.explication: We will definitely need the fire services.

fiches.question: Very probably.
fiches.explication: It is most likely a sensor fault.

fiches.question: Supposed to be true from what you know, though not certain.
fiches.explication: Presumably the runway will reopen after the inspection.

fiches.question: According to what you have heard or seen, though it may not be true.
fiches.explication: Apparently there is a strike at the destination.

fiches.question: According to a claim that has not been proved.
fiches.explication: The passenger allegedly hit a crew member.

fiches.question: Uncertain, not likely.
fiches.explication: It is doubtful that we can land before the curfew.

fiches.question: Probably not going to happen.
fiches.explication: A further delay is unlikely.

fiches.question: Certain to happen.
fiches.explication: It's bound to get busier after the closure.

fiches.question: It is likely that.
fiches.explication: Chances are the airport will close for snow.

fiches.question: (Informal) Certainly not.
fiches.explication: No way we can make that slot.

fiches.question: I don't think so.
fiches.explication: Will the fog lift? I doubt it.

fiches.question: (Informal, mostly British) I think; Americans often say "I guess".
fiches.explication: I reckon we'll be holding for twenty minutes.

fiches.question: According to my knowledge, which may be incomplete.
fiches.explication: As far as I know, the ILS is back in service.

fiches.question: (British) Likely to happen; Americans say "in the cards".
fiches.explication: A diversion is on the cards if the weather gets worse.

fiches.question: Not certainly, not in every case.
fiches.explication: A warning does not necessarily mean a failure.

fiches.question: It is not yet known.
fiches.explication: It remains to be seen whether the runway will be cleared in time.

fiches.question: Apparently, though perhaps not really.
fiches.explication: The seemingly minor fault grounded the aircraft.

fiches.question: In the end, after a long time or a lot of effort; "possibly" would be "potentially".
fiches.explication: We eventually landed after two hours of holding.

fiches.question: In fact, really; "at the moment" would be "currently".
fiches.explication: Actually, the fault cleared on its own.

fiches.question: At the present time.
fiches.explication: The runway is currently closed.

fiches.question: Showing good judgement.
fiches.explication: Diverting was the sensible decision.

fiches.question: Reacting quickly to small changes, or easily hurt or upset.
fiches.explication: The sensor is very sensitive to moisture.

fiches.question: To examine something to make sure it is correct or safe.
fiches.explication: Please check the cargo door.

fiches.question: To succeed in reaching a goal; "to finish" is "to complete".
fiches.explication: We achieved a stable approach at 1,000 feet.

fiches.question: To be present at an event; it does not mean "to wait for".
fiches.explication: All pilots must attend the safety briefing.

fiches.question: A place where you can borrow books; a shop selling books is a bookshop.
fiches.explication: The manuals are in the company library.

fiches.question: A period of time by which something is late.
fiches.explication: Expect a delay of thirty minutes.

fiches.question: The latest time by which something must be done.
fiches.explication: The deadline for the report is Friday.

fiches.question: To start again after a pause.
fiches.explication: Resume own navigation.

fiches.question: To give the main points briefly.
fiches.explication: Let me summarise the situation.

fiches.question: A chance to do something.
fiches.explication: We had no opportunity to dump fuel.

fiches.question: Making someone believe something that is not true.
fiches.explication: The investigation found no deception by the crew.

fiches.question: The feeling when something is not as good as you hoped.
fiches.explication: The cancellation was a big disappointment for the passengers.

fiches.question: What happens automatically when no other choice is made.
fiches.explication: The default setting is medium.

fiches.question: A place or position; renting something is "hire" or "rental".
fiches.explication: Confirm the location of the stranded vehicle.
